summary.name: Heynote
summary.one_liner: Heynote is a dedicated scratchpad for developers that provides a large, persistent text buffer divided into separate blocks.
use_cases: Drafting a message you don't want to send accidentally
Inspecting a JSON response from an API
Jotting down quick developer scratch notes
summary.what_it_does: Heynote is a large, persistent text buffer divided into blocks. Pressing ⌘-Enter creates a new block. Pressing ⌘-A inside a block selects only that block's content. The page suggests uses such as drafting messages, examining API JSON responses, meeting notes, and daily to-do lists. The page text does not describe further features in detail.
notable: Single persistent text buffer split into independent blocks
⌘-Enter creates a new block; ⌘-A selects just the current block
Listed as freeware and open-source in awesome-mac
caveats: Platform support beyond macOS is not stated on the page
Detailed feature list and pricing details are not given on the page
